verdict.rationale: Oneleet documents per-integration pages under /integrations/ for AWS (resources monitored via an AssumeRole role you can delete), GitHub (configuration, user access and Dependabot, with no repository-contents access), and Google Workspace (user accounts, Gmail settings). Device management is covered by Oneleet's own native MDM rather than a third-party connector. That covers cloud, identity and code hosting, but other parts of the story are unevidenced. Missing for 10: HR integrations, ticketing integrations, other cloud and identity providers (e.g. Azure, GCP, Okta), explicit read-only scope documentation (the AWS role permissions are not described as read-only), a browsable full catalog, and independent corroboration.
